create_distributed_sampler: create a DistributedSampler to split a PyTorch dataset across multiple GPU replicas with optional shuffling
use_distributed_sampler_set_epoch: use the set_epoch method on DistributedSampler to change the random seed for each training epoch
create_uniform_clip_sampler: create a UniformClipSampler to sample equally spaced video clips from a VideoClips dataset with a max per video
create_random_clip_sampler: create a RandomClipSampler to randomly sample video clips from a VideoClips dataset with a max per video
review_sampler_classes: review the DistributedSampler, UniformClipSampler, and RandomClipSampler classes for PyTorch video data sampling strategies
